# discord_welcome_screen (Resource)

Manages the welcome screen shown to new members of a Community server. Each server has one welcome screen, so destroying this resource disables it and leaves its description and channels unchanged. Requires Community and the Manage Server permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_welcome_screen" "main" {
  server_id   = var.server_id
  enabled     = true
  description = "A place to talk about everything."

  welcome_channels = [
    {
      channel_id  = discord_text_channel.rules.id
      description = "Read the rules first"
      emoji_name  = "📜"
    },
    {
      channel_id  = discord_text_channel.general.id
      description = "Say hello"
      emoji_id    = discord_emoji.wave.id
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the welcome screen is shown.
- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Optional

- `audit_log_reason` (String) Reason recorded in the server's audit log for changes this resource makes, overriding the provider's `audit_log_reason`. Up to 512 characters. Changing only this argument updates state without calling Discord.
- `description` (String) Server description shown on the welcome screen (up to 140 characters).
- `welcome_channels` (Attributes List) Channels shown on the welcome screen, in order (at most 5). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--welcome_channels))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server ID.

<a id="nestedatt--welcome_channels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `welcome_channels`

Required:

- `channel_id` (String) ID of the channel.
- `description` (String) Description shown for the channel (up to 50 characters).

Optional:

- `emoji_id` (String) ID of a custom server emoji shown for the channel.
- `emoji_name` (String) Unicode emoji shown for the channel, or the name of the custom emoji in `emoji_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = discord_welcome_screen.main
  identity = {
    server_id = "234567890123456789"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import discord_welcome_screen.main <server_id>
```
